limits: The GIS ring is a source footprint and does not define story count, roof, window locations, entrance orientation or interior.
The chapter drawing is stylized secondary visual material, not an architectural survey/photo.
GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the two facade levels depicted in the illustration; source field and picture are both retained with the conflict documented.
GIS Extrution=12 has no supplied units or definition and is not treated as height.
The west-facing entry orientation is provisional from the 427 N Russell address and the modeled footprint; no source elevation establishes the entry side.
No floor plan or interior photo was found; the displayed one-level interior is schematic and not as-built.
